status.cranks-dungeons.fire_resistance: +%s percentage points of Fire Resistance. Total Fire Resistance is capped at 75%%.
status.cranks-dungeons.resistance: +%s Armor, which reduces physical hit damage.
status.cranks-dungeons.regeneration: +%s health recovered per second through the regeneration system.
status.cranks-dungeons.regeneration.extr: Drowning blocks health recovery. Vaal Pact prevents regeneration. Zealot's Oath redirects regeneration to Energy Shield.
status.cranks-dungeons.weakness: %s%% reduced physical damage. This effect is capped at 100%% reduction.
status.cranks-dungeons.slowness: %s%% reduced movement speed. The effect is capped at 90%% reduced speed.
status.cranks-dungeons.haste: +%s%% mining speed. With Conduit Power, the stronger mining bonus applies.
status.cranks-dungeons.mining_fatigue: %s%% reduced mining speed. The effect is capped at 90%% reduced speed.
status.cranks-dungeons.health_boost: +%s maximum health. Existing health is limited to the new maximum when this ends.
status.cranks-dungeons.health_boost.extr: Increasing maximum health does not heal the added capacity.
status.cranks-dungeons.absorption: +%s temporary absorption health. Damage consumes it before normal health.
status.cranks-dungeons.absorption.extra: Remaining absorption from this effect expires with the effect.
status.cranks-dungeons.unluck: %s%% reduced rarity of items found. This effect is capped at 100%% reduction.
status.cranks-dungeons.instant_health: Restores %s health instantly. Deals the same amount as Void damage to undead instead.
status.cranks-dungeons.instant_health.ex: Drowning blocks healing. Void damage consumes Energy Shield at twice the normal rate.
status.cranks-dungeons.instant_damage: Deals %s Void damage before Void Resistance. Heals undead by that amount instead.
status.cranks-dungeons.instant_damage.ex: Void damage consumes Energy Shield at twice the normal rate.
status.cranks-dungeons.poison: Applies %s Poison stacks. Each new stack deals 1 Void damage every 0.5 seconds before Void Resistance.
status.cranks-dungeons.poison.extra: Stacks with existing Poison up to its cap and bypasses Energy Shield. Stacks expire one at a time, resetting the timer for the remaining stacks. Reduced Poison Duration shortens each timer.
status.cranks-dungeons.wither: Reduces Fire, Cold, Lightning, and Void Resistance by %s percentage points.
status.cranks-dungeons.jump_boost: +%s blocks/tick of initial jump velocity and %s blocks of fall-damage allowance.
status.cranks-dungeons.nausea: Distorts the view. Visual strength follows the Distortion Effects setting.
status.cranks-dungeons.water_breathing: Stops air loss and drowning while submerged in water.
status.cranks-dungeons.invisibility: Hides your body and reduces mob detection. Worn armor and held items remain visible.
status.cranks-dungeons.invisibility.extr: Mob detection range is 7%% of normal with no armor, or 17.5%% per worn armor piece, up to 70%% with all four pieces.
status.cranks-dungeons.blindness: Restricts visibility to approximately 5 blocks and prevents starting a sprint.
status.cranks-dungeons.night_vision: Brightens dark areas to full visual brightness. It changes visibility, not actual block light.
status.cranks-dungeons.hunger: Adds %s exhaustion per second, costing about 1 hunger point every %s seconds while saturation is empty.
status.cranks-dungeons.saturation: Restores %s hunger points per tick, up to the normal hunger maximum.
status.cranks-dungeons.saturation.extra: The mod clears saturation, so this effect restores hunger only.
status.cranks-dungeons.glowing: Adds a colored silhouette visible through solid blocks.
status.cranks-dungeons.levitation: Accelerates vertical motion toward %s blocks/second upward while the effect is active.
status.cranks-dungeons.slow_falling: Limits downward speed to approximately 2.5 blocks/second and prevents fall damage.
status.cranks-dungeons.conduit_power: Provides underwater breathing and underwater vision. Also grants +%s%% mining speed, using the stronger bonus if Haste is active.
status.cranks-dungeons.dolphins_grace: Reduces water drag while swimming, preserving momentum and increasing swimming speed.
status.cranks-dungeons.bad_omen: Entering a village starts Raid Omen. Approaching an eligible trial spawner starts Trial Omen.
status.cranks-dungeons.raid_omen: A raid begins near the stored village position when this countdown expires.
status.cranks-dungeons.trial_omen: Converts eligible nearby trial spawners into ominous trial spawners for harder encounters and their rewards.
status.cranks-dungeons.hero_of_the_villa: Grants a base %s%% discount on eligible villager trades, rounded down and limited to a minimum price of 1.
Trade demand and reputation still affect the final price. Nearby villagers may give gifts.
status.cranks-dungeons.darkness: Pulses a dark fog and reduces visibility. Visual intensity follows the Darkness Effects setting.
status.cranks-dungeons.wind_charged: Creates a wind burst on death that knocks nearby entities away.
status.cranks-dungeons.weaving: Moves through cobwebs more easily and can place 2–3 cobwebs around the death position.
status.cranks-dungeons.weaving.extra: Placement requires suitable space and follows the mobGriefing rule for mobs.
status.cranks-dungeons.oozing: Spawns 2 medium slimes on death, subject to the nearby-entity limit.
status.cranks-dungeons.infested: Each damage event has a 10%% chance to spawn 1–2 silverfish.
status.cranks-dungeons.hunger_high: Active at 16 or more hunger. Grants +10%% movement speed and +10%% attack speed.
status.cranks-dungeons.hunger_low: Active at 6 or less hunger. Applies 10%% reduced movement speed and 10%% reduced attack speed.
status.cranks-dungeons.burn: Fire damage over time, ticking every 0.5 seconds. Only the strongest Burn applies. Water halves its damage and makes it expire twice as fast.
status.cranks-dungeons.ailment_poison: %s independently timed Poison stacks. Uses Void Resistance and bypasses Energy Shield. The timer shows the next stack expiry; applying another stack does not refresh old stacks.
status.cranks-dungeons.freeze: Prevents movement and actions. Normal effect and hit-immunity timers continue. Followed by 1 second of shared Freeze/Electrocute recovery.
status.cranks-dungeons.bleed: Stores 40%% of later hit damage by default (up to 100%% with magnitude), then bursts when its 5-second base fuse expires. The burst bypasses Energy Shield.
status.cranks-dungeons.ailment_shock: +%s%% damage taken. Lightning hits can arc to nearby enemies within 10 blocks.
status.cranks-dungeons.electrocute: Prevents movement and actions. Followed by 1 second of shared Freeze/Electrocute recovery.

arrow.cranks-dungeons.poison.desc: On hit: applies 2 Poison stacks for 6 seconds. Poison uses Void Resistance and bypasses Energy Shield.

arrow.cranks-dungeons.weakening.desc: On hit: 20% reduced physical damage for 5 seconds. Repeated hits refresh the duration.
arrow.cranks-dungeons.marking.desc: On hit: outlines the target through obstacles for 10 seconds.
arrow.cranks-dungeons.void.desc: Converts 30% of the shot's physical damage to Void, sharing the 100% conversion limit with other conversions.
arrow.cranks-dungeons.void.extra: Uses Void Resistance. Void damage consumes Energy Shield at twice the normal rate.

crafting.cranks-dungeons.map_expand_hint: Doubles coverage in each direction. The preview shows the current map; the expanded area must be explored again. Existing copies keep their current scale.
crafting.cranks-dungeons.map_lock_hint: Freezes the map's explored terrain in a new map. Existing copies remain unchanged.

runic.cranks-dungeons.pool_present_hint: This rune family is already on the item. Ordinary additions cannot duplicate it; replacement and reroll operations have their own rules.
runic.cranks-dungeons.pool_full_hint: This affix side is full at its current rarity. Rarity upgrades and replacement operations can change its capacity.
runic.cranks-dungeons.pool_choose_tome: Choose a tome in the Tomes tab to filter its possible outcomes.
runic.cranks-dungeons.pool_removal_only: This tome removes a rune. It does not roll a new rune.
runic.cranks-dungeons.pool_hint: Inspect possible outcomes and value ranges. Selecting a rune here does not choose or generate a crafting result.
runic.cranks-dungeons.pool_filter_hint: Shows the selected tome's eligible families and capped tiers. Greater and Perfect random tomes exclude weaker tiers when the equipment permits. Browsing never rolls a result.
runic.cranks-dungeons.pool_targeted_hint: This rune is obtained through the listed targeted tomes, not the random pool. Each source shows its exact allowed tiers below.
runic.cranks-dungeons.pool_source_hint: Inspect each source and its eligible tiers in the right column. Artificial options are generated separately at the Artificial Runic Altar.
runic.cranks-dungeons.level_hint: Every tome respects the equipment tier cap. Greater and Perfect random tomes narrow the eligible tier range; they do not exclude build-defining rune families.
status.cranks-dungeons.ailment_dps: %s damage per second before resistance and Shock.
status.cranks-dungeons.burn_rules: Uses Fire Resistance. Energy Shield absorbs Burn. Water, rain and powder snow halve damage and double expiry speed.
status.cranks-dungeons.poison_rules: Uses Void Resistance and bypasses Energy Shield. Each stack keeps its own source and expiry.
status.cranks-dungeons.bleed_fraction: Stores %s%% of later hit damage; bursts on expiry and bypasses Energy Shield.
status.cranks-dungeons.ailment_cleanse: Milk clears ailments and beneficial effects; you must be able to use items.
